description: Construction of a single-storey side infill extension, including the demolition of existing outbuildings and the alteration of the existing rear extension. The existing single-storey rear extension will be demolished and reconstructed on the same footprint, with an increased height of 2.94m to align with the new extension and create a consistent roofline. The application also includes a first-floor side extension. This application also includes the replacement of the existing concrete roof tiles with fibre cement roof tiles.
